title: Empirical Boundaries of Reservoir Computing for Few-Shot Sequence Pattern Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.19997v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Efficient sequence modeling remains a fundamental challenge in machine learning. Despite the success of Transformers, recurrent neural networks (RNNs) have recently re-emerged as efficient alternatives. Particularly, Echo State Networks (ESNs) offer a compelling framework of randomized RNNs that have been extensively studied for time-series forecasting and dynamical systems. This paper presents an empirical analysis of distributional, architectural, and optimization variants of ESNs evaluated on few-shot sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) pattern tasks. These synthetic tasks utilize discrete symbol sequences, characterized by delays, inactive phases, and triggered markers to isolate and evaluate memory and pattern recognition capabilities. The minimality of these tasks is crucial to understand the strengths and limitations of machine learning models. translated_title: 储备池计算在少样本序列模式任务中的经验边界
translated_abstract: 高效的序列建模仍然是机器学习中的一项根本性挑战。尽管Transformer取得了巨大成功，循环神经网络（RNN）最近又重新成为高效的替代方案。特别是，回声状态网络（ESNs）提供了一种引人注目的随机化RNN框架，已被广泛研究用于时间序列预测和动力系统。本文对ESN在分布、架构和优化方面的各种变体进行了实证分析，并在少样本序列到序列（seq2seq）模式任务上进行了评估。这些合成任务利用离散符号序列构建，其特征包括延迟、静默阶段和触发标记，用以隔离并评估模型的记忆能力和模式识别能力。这些任务的极简性对于理解机器学习模型的优势与局限性至关重要。此外，当输入信号采用独热编码时，ESN的动力学受到……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过极简的少样本序列到序列模式任务，对回声状态网络（ESN）在分布、架构与优化层面的多种变体进行了实证评估，以刻画储备池计算在记忆与模式识别能力上的优势边界与局限。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically evaluates distributional, architectural, and optimization variants of Echo State Networks on minimal few-shot seq2seq pattern tasks to delineate the boundaries of reservoir computing's memory and pattern recognition capabilities.
